verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Alif-laam-raa tilka aayaatul-kitaabi wa qur'aanin mubeen
Rubamaa yawaddul-ladheena kafaroo law kaanoo muslimeen
Dharhum ya'kuloo wa yatamatta'oo wa yulhihimul-amalu fasawfa ya'lamoon
Wa maa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa wa lahaa kitaabun ma'loom
Maa tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahaa wa maa yasta'khiroon
Wa qaaloo yaa ayyuhal-ladhee nuzzila alayhidh-dhikru innaka lamajnoon
Law maa ta'teenaa bil-malaa'ikati in kunta minas-saadiqeen
Maa nunazzilul-malaa'ikata illaa bil-haqqi wa maa kaanoo idhan munzareen
Innaa nahnu nazzalnadh-dhikra wa innaa lahu lahaafizoon
Wa laqad arsalnaa min qablika fee shiya'il-awwaleen
Wa maa ya'teehim min rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihi yastahzi'oon
Kadhaalika naslukuhu fee quloobil-mujrimeen
Laa yu'minoona bihi wa qad khalat sunnatul-awwaleen
Wa law fatahnaa alayhim baaban minas-samaa'i fazalloo feehi ya'rujoon
Laqaaloo innamaa sukkirat absaarunaa bal nahnu qawmun mashooroon
Wa laqad ja'alnaa fis-samaa'i buroojan wa zayyannaahaa lin-naazireen
Wa hafiznaahaa min kulli shaytaanin rajeem
Illaa manis-taraqas-sam'a fa-atba'ahu shihaabun mubeen
Wal-arda madadnaahaa wa alqaynaa feehaa rawaasiya wa anbatnaa feehaa min kulli shay'in mawzoon
Wa ja'alnaa lakum feehaa ma'aayisha wa man lastum lahu biraaziqeen
Wa in min shay'in illaa indanaa khazaa'inuhu wa maa nunazziluhu illaa biqadarin ma'loom
Wa arsalnar-riyaaha lawaaqiha fa-anzalnaa minas-samaa'i maa'an fa-asqaynaakumoohu wa maa antum lahu bikhaazineen
Wa innaa lanahnu nuhyee wa numeetu wa nahnul-waarithoon
Wa laqad alimnal-mustaqdimeena minkum wa laqad alimnal-musta'khireen
Wa inna rabbaka huwa yahshuruhum innahu hakeemun aleem
Wa laqad khalaqnal-insaana min salsaalin min hama'iin masnoon
Wal-jaanna khalaqnaahu min qablu min naaris-samoom
Wa idh qaala rabbuka lilmalaa'ikati innee khaaliqun basharan min salsaalin min hama'iin masnoon
Fa-idhaa sawwaytuhu wa nafakhtu feehi min roohee faqa'oo lahu saajideen
Fasajadal-malaa'ikatu kulluhum ajma'oon
Illaa ibleesa abaa an yakoona ma'as-saajideen
Qaala yaa ibleesu maa laka allaa takoona ma'as-saajideen
Qaala lam akun li'sjuda libasharin khalaqtahu min salsaalin min hama'iin masnoon
Qaala fakhruj minhaa fa-innaka rajeem
Wa inna alaykal-la'nata ilaa yawmid-deen
Qaala rabbi fa-anzirnee ilaa yawmi yub'athoon
Qaala fa-innaka minal-munzareen
Ilaa yawmil-waqtil-ma'loom
Qaala rabbi bimaa aghwaytanee la-uzayyinanna lahum fil-ardi wa la-ughwiyannahum ajma'een
Illaa ibaadaka minhumul-mukhlaseen
Qaala haadhaa siraatun alayya mustaqeem
Inna ibaadee laysa laka alayhim sultaanun illaa manit-taba'aka minal-ghaaween
Wa inna jahannama lamaw'iduhum ajma'een
Lahaa sab'atu abwaabin likulli baabin minhum juz'un maqsoom
Innal-muttaqeena fee jannaatin wa uyoon
Udkhuloohaa bisalaamin aamineen
Wa naza'naa maa fee sudoorihim min ghillin ikhwaanan alaa sururin mutaqaabileen
Laa yamassuhum feehaa nasabun wa maa hum minhaa bimukhrajeen
Nabbi ibaadee annee anal-ghafoorur-Raheem
Wa anna adhaabee huwal-adhaabul-aleem
Wa nabbi'hum an dayfi ibraaheem
Idh dakhaloo alayhi faqaaloo salaaman qaala innaa minkum wajiloon
Qaaloo laa tawjal innaa nubashshiruka bighulaamin aleem
Qaala abashshartumoonee alaa an massaniyal-kibaru fabima tubashshiroon
Qaaloo bashsharnaaka bil-haqqi falaa takun minal-qaaniteen
Qaala wa man yaqnatu min rahmati rabbihi illad-daalloon
Qaala famaa khatbukum ayyuhal-mursaloon
Qaaloo innaa ursilnaa ilaa qawmin mujrimeen
Illaa aala lootin innaa lamunajjoohum ajma'een
Illam-ra'atahu qaddarnaa innahaa laminal-ghaabireen
Falammaa jaa'a aala lootin al-mursaloon
Qaala innakum qawmun munkaroon
Qaaloo bal ji'naaka bimaa kaanoo feehi yamtaroon
Wa ataynaaka bil-haqqi wa innaa lasaadiqoon
Fa-asri bi-ahlika biqit'in minal-layli wattabi adbaarahum wa laa yaltafit minkum ahadun wamdoo haythu tu'maroon
Wa qadaynaa ilayhi dhaalikal-amra anna daabira haa'ulaa'i maqtoo'un musbiheen
Wa jaa'a ahlul-madeenati yastabshiroon
Qaala inna haa'ulaa'i dayfee falaa tafdahoon
Wattaqoo Allaaha wa laa tukhzoon
Qaaloo awalam nanhaka anil-aalameen
Qaala haa'ulaa'i banaatee in kuntum fa-ileen
La-amruka innahum lafee sakratihim ya'mahoon
Fa-akhadhathumus-sayhatu mushriqeen
Faja'alnaa aaliyahaa saafilahaa wa amtarnaa alayhim hijaaratan min sijjeel
Inna fee dhaalika la-aayaatin lilmutawassimeen
Wa innahaa labisabeelin muqeem
Inna fee dhaalika la-aayatan lilmu'mineen
Wa in kaana ashaabul-aykati lazaalimeen
Fantaqamnaa minhum wa innahumaa labi'imaamin mubeen
Wa laqad kadhdhaba ashaabul-hijril-mursaleen
Wa aataynaahum aayaatinaa fakaanoo anhaa mu'rideen
Wa kaanoo yanhitoona minal-jibaali buyootan aamineen
Fa-akhadhathumus-sayhatu musbiheen
Famaa aghnaa anhum maa kaanoo yaksiboon
Wa maa khalaqnas-samaawaati wal-arda wa maa baynahumaa illaa bil-haqqi wa innas-saa'ata la-aatiyatun fasfahis-safhal-jameel
Inna rabbaka huwal-khallaaqul-aleem
Wa laqad aataynaaka sab'an minal-mathaanee wal-qur'aanal-azeem
Laa tamuddanna aynayka ilaa maa matta'naa bihi azwaajan minhum wa laa tahzan alayhim wakhfid janaahaka lilmu'mineen
Wa qul innee anan-nadheerul-mubeen
Kamaa anzalnaa alal-muqtasimeen
Al-ladheena ja'alul-qur'aana ideen
Fawarabbika lanas'alannahum ajma'een
Ammaa kaanoo ya'maloon
Fasda bimaa tu'maru wa a'rid anil-mushrikeen
Innaa kafaynaakal-mustahzi'een
Al-ladheena yaj'aloona ma'a Allaahi ilahan aakhara fasawfa ya'lamoon
Wa laqad na'lamu annaka yadeequ sadruka bimaa yaqooloon
Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wa kun minas-saajideen
Wa'bud rabbaka hattaa ya'tiyakal-yaqeen
